subject: Security review kickoff & questionnaire intake - Medora Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@medorahealth.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2027 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Recap & next steps from discovery - security kickoff prep

Jordan — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our discovery call and suggested next steps so we can get your security review on a fast track.

What we heard (high level):
- Use case: customer-facing intelligent triage and summarization for provider intake.
- Data: PHI-adjacent (pseudonymized identifiers) ingested via API and S3; subset stored as embeddings.
- Deployment preference: initially Redwood Hosted for speed, with a plan to move to Dedicated/VPC within 6–9 months for data isolation.

Stakeholders you mentioned:
- Economic buyer: Samir Patel, VP Product (procurement/approvals)
- Security/Compliance: Aisha Roy (security lead)
- Procurement/Legal: Jordan (you) as procurement coordinator

Immediate next steps (proposed):
1) Please send us your security questionnaire (we can intake PDF or a spreadsheet). I’ve attached our short security overview to speed things up.
2) Confirm systems in scope: app backend (API), embeddings DB (managed), data lake (S3), logs/monitoring. If Medora plans to host in your VPC later, flag that.
3) Connect Aisha to our security engineer (Nikhil) to schedule a kickoff call for technical Q&A.
4) Share procurement timeline and any PO/contract redline contacts.

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf (attached).

Proposed times for kickoff: Thu 2/11 10:00–11:00 PT or Fri 2/12 9:00–10:00 PT — if one works, we’ll send a calendar invite with agenda and pre-read.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@medorahealth.com>

Cc: Aisha Roy <aisha.roy@medorahealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@medorahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2027 15:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps from discovery - security kickoff prep

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- Confirming scope: app backend (customer-facing API), S3 data lake, embeddings store (managed), and audit logs. We do not plan to include internal analytics infra at this stage.
- Security questionnaire: attaching our standard security intake (Medora_Security_Questionnaire.pdf). It’s a mix of yes/no + evidence sections.
- Procurement timeline: we’re aiming to complete security review by end of March. Procurement needs: PO + standard SOW; I’ve attached the procurement checklist for your internal review.
- Economic buyer: Samir is looped — he will make the final sign-off on budget.

Aisha — can you confirm availability for the technical kickoff? We’d like a short call to walk the questionnaire and get a list of evidence artifacts.

Attachments: Medora_Security_Questionnaire.pdf, Medora_Procurement_Checklist.xlsx

Best,
Jordan
Lead Procurement Manager | Medora Health
jordan.ellis@medorahealth.com

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2027 16:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps from discovery - security kickoff prep

Marissa — thanks for the thread. A few technical Qs before we engage Aisha:

1) Systems in scope — can you confirm whether the embeddings store is a managed 3rd-party service (e.g., Pinecone/Weaviate) or a self-hosted Redis/Milvus instance? If managed, we need vendor SOC2 evidence.
2) Is any raw PHI stored in S3, or only pseudonymized tokens? If raw PHI is stored at rest, that increases controls we’ll need to present (encryption/HSM, access logs).
3) What auth flows are used for the API (mTLS, API key, OAuth)?

I’ll draft a short evidence checklist once we have answers so Aisha knows exactly what we can provide by the kickoff.

—Nikhil
Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@medorahealth.com>, Aisha Roy <aisha.roy@medorahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2027 09:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Systems in scope & proposed evidence list

Folks — following up with the details Nikhil requested so we can make kickoff productive.

Confirmed scope (Medora confirmation on 2/10):
- Customer-facing API (hosted on Redwood Hosted cluster) — endpoints for intake and summarization.
- Data lake: S3 buckets in us-west-2 (customer-managed) used for batch ingestion.
- Embeddings store: initially using Redwood-managed embeddings (encrypted at rest) with plan to migrate to customer-managed solution in Dedicated/VPC later.
- Logs/monitoring: aggregated to Redwood-managed observability (logs redacted for PII).

Preliminary evidence we can provide for kickoff:
- SOC 2 report (Redwood) — redacted copy
- Network diagram showing flow from Medora API -> Redwood ingress -> model runtime -> embeddings store
- Encrypt-at-rest configs for embeddings and S3 (KMS usage)
- Data retention & deletion workflow (how we purge embeddings and customer data)
- IAM roles & least privilege summary for caretaking accounts
- Sample audit logs (redacted) showing access patterns

Proposed kickoff slots: Thu 2/11 10:00 PT (confirmed for us) or Fri 2/12 09:00 PT. Jordan/Aisha — please confirm which works. I’ll include an agenda: 1) questionnaire walkthrough, 2) evidence mapping, 3) timeline for deliverables.

Thanks —
Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Quoted: Jordan’s questionnaire attached (Medora_Security_Questionnaire.pdf)

From: Aisha Roy <aisha.roy@medorahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@medorahealth.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@medorahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 10:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Systems in scope & proposed evidence list

Thanks Marissa — Friday 2/12 09:00 PT works for our security team. Appreciate the clear evidence list; a couple of additional asks before the call:

- Can you provide the following artifacts ahead of time so our security ops can triage?
  • Redacted SOC 2 (latest)
  • Network diagram (as PNG/PDF) with ports and IP ranges
  • Example API auth flow (sequence diagram or flow)
  • Encryption at transit details (TLS versions, cipher suites)

- A note on embeddings: since you’re using Redwood-managed embeddings now, please confirm the tenancy model (per-customer index vs shared index) and whether vectors are salted/hashed. That will determine what evidence we need.

We’ll use the call to confirm answers and mark any open items. Our timeline goal remains end of March.

I’ve attached a short internal mapping template that we’ll fill during the kickoff (Medora_Security_Questionnaire.pdf includes the template).

See you on Friday —
Aisha Roy
Security Lead | Medora Health
aisha.roy@medorahealth.com
